desc: Savage once again proves there's no limit to the adaptability of the Model 110. The new 110 PCS is a bolt-action pistol built around the 110s factory blueprinted action. The 110 PCS has a user-adjustable AccuTrigger for a crisp, clean pull. The action is secured in a one-piece aluminum chassis from Modular Driven Technologies (MDT) and includes an AICS-style detachable box magazine. The 110 PCS combines compact performance with the Model 110s exceptional reputation for accuracy and reliability. This Model is Left-Hand Bolt, Right-Side Ejection. Accepts most AR-15 pistol grips.
